title: 第23章 和铃央央（求追读）
novel_title: 恶毒女配又装纯，禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
和铃展颜一笑，“多谢小齐师兄。”

    她蹲下身，解开小麒麟身上的枷锁，神色温柔地摸了摸它的脖子。

    “虽然我不能给你绝对的自由，但也绝不会用锁链困住你。”

    “我的名字你已经知道了，龙旂阳阳，和铃央央。我叫和铃，小字央央，你也可以唤我阿铃。”

    “你呢，小麒麟，我还不知道你的名字呢。”

    “吟~吟~”没有名字。

    小麒麟高傲地仰着头。

    和铃想了想，说道：“鳞介尊神龙，走兽宗麒麟，以后你就叫介宗吧！”

    第五齐张了张嘴想说什么，但是见和铃和小麒麟满脸兴奋，他决定闭嘴。

    算了，和铃她喜欢给小麒麟起什么名字就起什么名字吧，反正这是她的坐骑。

    和小麒麟契约之后，和铃翻身上背，乘着玄墨麒麟在宗门内兜风了几圈。

    看着天上如彗星划过的墨绿流光，吕温良直摇头，“如此大张旗鼓，让那些错失了玄墨麒麟的弟子心里怎么想？”

    “从前的和铃只是追着夜弦身后跑，就算引起非议，也是混元峰和一尘峰两峰之间的事情，如今怕是要引起大半个宗门的不满了。”

    果然，第二天吕温良就收到了不少弟子的投诉。

    “宗主，我理解和铃师姐契约了玄墨麒麟的喜悦，但她大半夜都还骑着玄墨麒麟在宗门内跑来跑去，实在影响弟子子夜修炼。”

    修行讲究心无杂念，和铃在天上炫耀她的灵兽，他心平气和得下来才怪。

    “是啊宗主，和铃师姐此举和在宗门内跑马有何分别？麒麟叫声清亮，都惊到弟子豢养的灵兽了。”

    “宗规有言，子夜过后禁止御剑飞行，小麒麟虽然不是飞剑，但也不应该成为例外，不管怎么说，它也是在御空。”

    听着大家七嘴八舌的声音，吕温良摆了摆手，说道：“你们说的事情我都知道了，我会派人去提醒和铃，遵守宗门规定，不要在半夜溜麒麟了。”

    “多谢宗主。”

    “弟子无事了。”

    “弟子也没有事了，先告退。”

    大家前后脚走出大殿，吕温良派了个弟子去混元峰将此事告知了和铃。
content_en:
Six days later.

Nanhua Sect, the ceremony of recognizing the master of the sacred beast.

"Today's recognition ceremony of the sacred beast should have been held long ago, but I didn't expect that the sect master changed his order day and night and delayed it for so many days."

"Alas, in fact, this is not all the fault of the sect master. It's not true that Lord Mingse did not allow the divine beast recognition ceremony to be held as scheduled."

"Oh, I heard about this. I heard that He Ling is not in the sect. True Lord Mingse requested that He Ling come back before choosing the master of the divine beast. Otherwise, it would be unfair to He Ling."

"Didn't He Ling come back two days ago? Then why was it delayed again?"

"Choose an auspicious day."

"Nonsense, the latter time was requested by Zhenjun Weichen. It seems that it was because Senior Brother Ye was away."

"...I really envy them, disciples of True Monarch Nascent Soul, for keeping good things for them."

A dusty peak.

Zhenjun Weichen looked at the disciples who hurried back, "Where have you been these days? Don't you know that the selection of the master of the divine beast is just around the corner? If I hadn't fought for you, little Qilin would never have your share!"

Ye Xian cupped his hands and said, "Disciple knows that he was wrong. I hope master will calm down."

He is indeed an outstanding disciple. He is already in the Golden Core realm at a young age. He has gained a lot of face outside. Zhenjun Weichen looked slightly relaxed and warned:

"This time when choosing the master of the divine beast, you try to make a contract with the Xuanmo Qilin. In the future, the little Qilin will assist you in your practice, and the people from Hunyuan Peak will not be able to catch up with you."

Ye Xian was stunned for a moment, and quickly realized who the person in Zhenjun Weichen's mouth was referring to.

Looking at the entire Nanhua Sect, there is only one person who can rival him in cultivation, and that is He Ling.

No matter how hard he practiced, He Ling's cultivation kept rising and he soon caught up with him.

The problem is that He Ling rarely puts his mind on cultivation.

She truly relies on pure talent.

Ye Xian still had He Ling's things in his sleeves. He slightly lowered his eyes and said, "Disciple will work hard for it."

"It's almost time, go ahead." Zhenjun Weichen said casually.

Ye Xian said goodbye to True Lord Weichen and returned to his cave first.

"Today is the day when the beast chooses its master. Senior sister, please come with me."

"Me?" Cheng Qianhe was slightly startled, not expecting Ye Xian to call her.

Ye Xian nodded and said: "The sect leader made it clear that all inner disciples of Nanhua Sect can participate in this ceremony. Senior sister is also an inner disciple, so of course you can give it a try."

He hopes that Cheng Qianhe and Xiao Qilin will make a contract.

In this way, with little Qilin watching over Cheng Xianhe, he no longer has to worry about Cheng Xianhe's safety.

To put it bluntly, he wants to be the hands-off shopkeeper.

Ye Xian knew very well that Liang Qiu'er lost a golden elixir for him, and Liang Zhenjun must make him compensate Liang Qiu'er.
